derivation.behavior: Aria2 GID is bound durably to attempt generation before activation.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Go creates task paused where possible, persists GID/runtime ownership then activates.

invariants: A GID is never a sufficient writer identity; download, attempt generation, runtime identity, GID, and staging identity form the durable authority tuple.
The external aria2 task is created paused where possible and cannot write canonically before Ready ownership becomes Active.
A daemon restart may reuse a GID only through a fresh attempt generation after staging identity proof; the stale runtime tuple remains fenced.
Activation without durable ownership is forbidden.
